dry_run.description: If true, show what would be merged without actually modifying any files

on_duplicate.description: How to handle duplicate component names: 'skip' (ignore duplicates), 'error' (fail on duplicates), 'rename' (auto-rename with suffix). Default: 'error'

source_filepaths.description: Array of paths to source library files (.PcbLib or .SchLib)

target_filepath.description: Path to the target library file (will be created or appended to)
